description: This file defines a utility function for rendering an RSS feeds form within the Rss module of a CRM application. It initializes an RSS object, retrieves RSS feed HTML, and constructs an HTML table for display.

classes.name: vtigerRSS
classes.description: A class responsible for handling RSS feed operations within the module.

methods.name: get_rssfeeds_form
methods.description: Generates an HTML form displaying RSS feeds within a table layout.
